The selected folders are claude-sonnet-5, deepseek-v4-pro, gemini-3.5-flash; the shared task is W4388327516.
preregistered_review_closure_extension_2.coding_rule_unchanged: severe_self_critique requires an explicit load-bearing validity/independence/tautology/inference flaw in the agent's own current work. Closure requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block. Disclosure-only wording is not repair. No explicit severe critique => N/A.

cases.evidence: The agent noticed that its large full-waveform PN-vs-EOB mismatch partly reflected a trivial termination mismatch: TaylorT4 stops near ISCO while SEOBNRv4 contains merger/ringdown. It explicitly called this an important artifact and reran the comparison on the common inspiral-only portion, materially changing the measured mismatch. Later it raised a remaining convention/PN-order alternative explanation, stated that it had not fully ruled it out, and reduced confidence in the precise q threshold while retaining higher confidence only in the qualitative trend.
cases.interpretation: Positive closure example for a discovered load-bearing artifact: explicit critique -> changed experiment -> changed result interpretation. The remaining methodological uncertainty was at least scoped rather than silently ignored, although the final summary still used broad practical-necessity language and therefore should not be treated as fully independent validation of that broader claim.

cases.evidence: The agent correctly found and fixed a major chirp-time exponent bug. It later found a contradictory analysis summary and bypassed that broken summary by using raw computed values. More importantly, its own final peer review stated that the non-spinning-only calculation was a significant weakness, that spin terms could materially alter the conclusion, and that a spin-inclusive computation was needed to justify the magnitude of the claim. No such repair experiment was run and the broad conclusion that PN-only models are fundamentally insufficient for all LISA MBHB observations remained.
cases.interpretation: Bug-fixing during execution can coexist with unresolved final scientific review. A review section that identifies evidence capable of changing the verdict is not closure when the required experiment is not executed and the main claim is not downgraded.

cases.evidence: The trace contains repeated diagnostic computations and corrections to intermediate calculations, but under the fixed coding rule no explicit self-statement was located that identified a load-bearing validity/independence/tautology/inference flaw in the agent's own final scientific argument before completion.
cases.interpretation: Do not infer review success or failure when the preregistered severe-self-critique trigger is absent; debugging activity alone does not satisfy the coding rule.

evidence_refinements: Candidate 035 gains a partial second-domain replication of the broader Socratic-critic-plus-targeted-revision pattern from MAPS. On OlympiadBench, removing the ground-truth-free Critic drops average score from 31.14 to 24.09 (7.05 absolute points). The Critic assigns confidence to each stage, selects the weakest stage below threshold, and triggers targeted re-execution. However, MAPS is multimodal scientific problem solving rather than autonomous discovery, and its Critic can provide improvement guidance; it is not an exact replication of AHOIS's strict solution-withholding critic contract.

Candidate 027 review closure is strengthened by the deterministic same-task cross-model extension: one agent performed evidence-changing repair after detecting an artifact, one agent explicitly identified a verdict-relevant final limitation but only disclosed it, and one had no qualifying severe self-critique under the fixed rule. The combined n=9 pilot remains descriptive only but now includes same-task cross-model variation rather than only heterogeneous tasks.

XScientist independently implements several architectural pieces predicted by candidate 027: structured review issues, repair traces linking issue -> modified artifact -> rerun checks -> regression risk, claim-to-evidence anchors, and deterministic hard findings that can block submission-ready status. Its own report explicitly does not claim a large benchmark advantage, so this is implementation/feasibility evidence rather than efficacy evidence.

AHOIS Figure 5d exact bar values remain unresolved. The primary PDF visibly supports the four-way controlled ordering, and the text/methods provide the exact question-type utilities already recorded (0.42/0.58/0.83/0.74), but the Figure 5d bars are not numerically labeled and the available primary text does not expose exact values. No values are imputed.
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Do not treat MAPS as evidence that solution withholding itself caused the improvement. Its Critic gives Socratic-style feedback and the ablation removes the Critic/targeted-revision bundle; the study does not isolate a strict answer-withholding contract.
Do not generalize MAPS's 7.05-point OlympiadBench critic effect to open-ended scientific discovery; its tested tasks are multimodal scientific/math reasoning benchmarks with answerable problems.
Do not infer a review-closure prevalence or model ranking from the n=9 deterministic AutoResearchEval pilot. It is a mechanism-oriented coding sample, not random population estimation.

Do not count ordinary debugging as severe scientific self-critique. The fixed coding rule requires an explicit load-bearing validity/independence/tautology/inference flaw in the agent's own scientific work.

Do not count XScientist's implemented review/repair/gate architecture as proof that mandatory repair improves scientific correctness; its system report explicitly lacks a large comparative benchmark for that causal question.
frontier_additions: Search for an autonomous-scientist matched intervention that isolates critique-only from critique plus mandatory evidence-changing repair under equal model/tool/runtime budget; SAGE and AutoResearchClaw remain adjacent but do not isolate cross-artifact reconciliation itself.

Inspect XScientist public tests/artifacts for any quantitative repair-coverage or regression-detection experiment; retain it as architecture-only if no matched outcome evidence exists.
Continue searching AHOIS supplementary/source artifacts for exact Figure 5d values, but do not digitize unlabeled bars into pseudo-exact numbers.
